name: Dark-throat shootingstar
desc: Dark-throat shootingstar (Dodecatheon pulchellum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 64 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Primula pauciflora, the pretty shooting star, few-flowered shooting star, dark throat shooting star or prairie shooting star, is a species of flowering plant in the primula family Primulaceae.
